data.name: Elwyn
data.gender_notes: Elwyn is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Welsh 'Ellywg', meaning 'elf friend'. This name has a strong connection to ancient Celtic spirituality, and is often associated with the mythological elves and fairies. The name Elwyn carries the meaning “Elf friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elwyn usually hope their child will grow to embody elf friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Elwyn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elf friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elwyn total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אלווין
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא חברי או אל הוא ידידי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלווין הוא שם פרטי שמשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא חברי' או 'אל הוא ידידי', מורכב מהמילים אל (אלוהים) ו-וין (חבר או ידיד). השם אלווין שייך למסורת הנוצרית והוא משמש לעתים קרובות כסמל לחברות אלוהית וליחסים קרובים עם האל.

in_greek.name: Έλγουιν
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Έλγουιν προέρχεται από τις Γαελικές λέξεις 'ailbh' που σημαίνει 'ευλογημένος' και 'win' που σημαίνει 'φίλος'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το Έλγουιν συμβολίζει τη φιλία με τον Θεό και την πνευματική σχέση.

in_latin.name: Elwyn
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elwyn originem habet in lingua Kymrica, significans 'Deus est amicus meus' vel 'Dei amicus'. In traditione Christiana, nomen Elwyn saepe datur in signum amicitiae cum Deo et devotionis ad Ipsum.

in_english.name: Elwyn
in_english.meaning: God is my friend or noble friend
in_english.long_meaning: The name Elwyn is of Welsh origin, derived from the Old Welsh words 'ail' meaning 'noble' and 'win' meaning 'friend'. In Christian tradition, Elwyn signifies a close and noble friendship with God, reflecting a deep spiritual connection and devotion. Historically, the name has been used in various forms across different cultures, often symbolizing a person's commitment to their faith and their relationship with the divine.
